column2: 『Yeah. I wish it'd stay like this』
Yes. I have to engrave it
Like all my worries could melt.
Oh, I'm tearing up a little…
but it's a bit too flashy
I wouldn't go that far, but…
I come, I don't get its appeal…
like this, how do I aim?
『Hit it anyhow, you may get lucky』
it's no fun unless you think,
Oh, I see. Not straight at it.
Yeah, this is a really hard shot.
But having to think in billiards
『Do that, and you can do math too』
Yes, and you can use cushions.
I don't get what's fun about it.
If you say so, maybe I'll try.
But maybe you get it once you play?
If you say so, maybe I'll try…
I don't really get it, but
Or am I that boring to be with?
I like it a lot myself.
Sure, but the beach is so packed,
There's something I must tell you…
What does she want to say?)
I went to another school a year.
One day, the club money vanished…
All knew an upperclassman took it.
But I didn't want the club shut down.
I thought that would fix it…
so long as I could play!
so I'm just like this tree.
Just a bit later than others.
If you rush to bloom early
no color or scent? What for?
Taking part is what counts, right?
Making so many bloom at once
must take a lot of hands.
『Maybe they just water them a bit』
without care, they don't bloom so.
won't make them bloom so well.
『A life with a fruiting, flowering tree』
『A life with fame and substance both』
Mei will send you to hospital.
『Yes, the mystic hues of sacred art』
They say angels have nine ranks,
so Mei thinks this is an angel
『So more people would see the art』
gods and angels are common there.
How is anyone supposed to study
a painting on a ceiling so high?
That is what a man is.
It's a fine place to unwind.
symbolizes the spirit of its time.
『Asian style may be the next trend』
If you can't sense those trends,
Mei won't talk to vulgar oafs.
Mei has piles of outfits made.
When she wants one, she'll buy it.
You may go home right now.
you heard it is fun, too.
Why put camo on a bear?
It may look like junk to most,
but to Mei, it is treasure.
『A lady like that is fine, I think』
Mei may well be a fine lady,
but she hates being called one.
『I know a shop where it's cheaper』
Fear not, Mei will give it to you.
Hmph, so what if it's cheap?
Mei can't resist parts like these.
『The Speech song the girls all love?』
doesn't make Mei happy at all.
You seem to like it too…
A stately gait, like ancient beasts!
The main difference is the frail legs.
Mei will ride that light float!
not that she wants to go home.
must get old if seen daily.
This won't work out with you.
but being lumped with a parade
『They're in a world of their own』
You like that sort of thing?
What would you say to strangers?
don't look half bad, it seems.
A coin toss to vow a return…
Mei finds it a lovely tale.
Then tell Mei, who built it?
yell it, push into a pond!
Mei is itching to try it
Staying with you longer is pointless!
It was like listening to a sutra.
Don't tell me, this concert again?
Mei isn't really in the mood.
Well, let's give it a try.
Do you even know the rules?
A sure bank shot it is.
Two balls went in at once.
『The cue ball dropped, so no count』
Bothering with you was a mistake.
Fun with you isn't half bad.
